summary: Wave 12 tooling/CI changes independently re-verified by actually executing commands, not trusting narrative: (1) ran 'pnpm exec tsc --noEmit' in packages/config,observability,schemas,utils individually -- all exit 0; ran 'pnpm turbo typecheck', 'pnpm --filter web build' (via scripts/run-vite.mjs, succeeded, 480kB+ bundle emitted) and vitest against files importing @music-os-360/config/environment (15/15 pass) to confirm the .js-suffixed barrel exports (Node16 moduleResolution requirement) resolve correctly for tsc, esbuild/Vite AND vitest, not just the package's own isolated tsc run -- apps/web's typecheck failures are pre-existing, unrelated naming-refactor bugs (observacoes/notes, listOperationalListItems) confirmed by exact error-message match against the wave's own DIVIDA_ACEITA text, not caused by this wave. (2) ran 'npx jest --silent' full suite from apps/api: 272/273 suites, 2446/2456 tests -- exact match to claim. (3) Ran the excluded audiovisual.dto.spec.ts directly and diagnosed root cause: CreateShotDto/UpdateShotDto/ReorderShotsDto/CreateTaskDto/UpdateTaskDto/CreateTeamMemberDto/TASK_STATUSES are genuinely absent from audiovisual.dto.ts (grepped whole module, only spec references them); class-validator's 'unknownValue' runtime error on undefined targets confirms it. Cross-checked against the recorded finding (find-9ab67e64): its text is accurate and appropriately scoped as HIGH/DIVIDA_ACEITA pre-existing Wave-9 debt, not fabricated to dodge work -- it correctly flags that shots.controller.ts uses plain TS interfaces (CreateShotInput/UpdateShotInput) with zero class-validator enforcement, confirmed by reading the controller. (4) Ran integrations.dto.spec.ts (13/13 pass) and integrations.oauth-security.spec.ts (2/2 pass) directly; confirmed via grep that integrationPolicy (16th ctor arg, stubbed as noop) is used only in listExternalProviders(), never in oauthExchange/oauthStatus/oauthDisconnect -- the noop stub does not disable any security check the tested methods exercise. (5) Ran 'pnpm --filter api lint' and 'pnpm --filter web lint': both exit 0, 0 errors (1093 and 442 warnings respectively) -- no-unused-vars change is additive only. (6) Spot-checked 3 DIVIDA_ACEITA entries against real files: express ^5.2.1 vs @types/express ^4.17.21 confirmed in package.json; all 8 dependency-audit-waivers.json entries confirmed reviewBy 2026-09-30; apps/web typecheck failure text matches actual tsc output character-for-character. Attempted to break: reverting-in-head the .js barrel suffix mentally against Node16 resolution rules, checked real bundler/test-runner behavior instead of assuming; checked whether the 4 new integrations DTOs are wired into the controller (they are not -- but this gap is itself already recorded as a separate DIVIDA_ACEITA finding, not silently hidden). No reproducible regression or fabricated disposition found in this wave's actual diff.
